claims.statement: Tom Allen had all along been the recognized champion of America.
claims.excerpt: who has all along been the recognized champion of America

claims.statement: Tom Allen was expected to recross the Atlantic to contest John Dwyer's claim to the title.
claims.excerpt: it is now more than probable that Tom Allen, the renowned pugilist, who has all along been the recognized champion of America, will re-cross the Atlantic for the purpose of contesting

claims.statement: A backer of Allen's said that his brother was then in England and that there was hardly any doubt Tom Allen would accompany him back to America.
claims.excerpt: States that bis brother is now in En- giand, and that there is hardiy any doubt that Tom will accompany him on bis return to America

claims.statement: Allen's friends in America were willing to make a match with Dwyer for as much money as the opposition wanted.
claims.excerpt: they are willing to make the match foras mach money as the op- position desire

notes: The paper's own description of Allen's standing and a St. Louis backer's account, both unattributed by name. No direct speech from Allen.
